items.text: Kickoff 1:00 p.m. ET. Philadelphia (final): OUT - WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot), LB Zack Baun (back). DOUBTFUL - LB Smael Mondon Jr. (ankle). QUESTIONABLE - RB Will Shipley (needs IR activation). EDGE Jonathan Greenard (ankle) DNP Fri but no designation. WR DeVonta Smith good to go. Jalen Hurts on IR; Joe Milton III starts (2nd straight), Tanner McKee backup.

Pittsburgh (final): LB Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) DNP all week - Steelers list him questionable, NFL.com out; unlikely to play. QUESTIONABLE - LB Patrick Queen (hand), WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR return), WR Roman Wilson (hand), G Gennings Dunker (knee), S DeShon Elliott (knee). G Mason McCormick on IR (Spencer Anderson starts). Aaron Rodgers starts.
